## Facets

- [How it works](llms-full.txt#how-it-works): For a Case alert implemented as a Salesforce; Production Flow deployment and activation are separate by; For native Case escalation rules, activating a rule — 9 units
- [Problems, failure modes and limitations](llms-full.txt#problems-failure-modes-and-limitations): Before deleting an active Flow version, deactivate it. A Flow with paused; Miguel Diaz initially reported that switching a screen Flow version would fail — 2 units
- [Comparisons and alternatives](llms-full.txt#comparisons-and-alternatives): JSBC Labs recommends recording the target Flow API name, expected version, activation method, owner and verification window in a release manifest. This is operational advice for making the activated alert logic traceable, rather than a Salesforce-enforced manifest format. — 1 unit
